  dc=(-min(cs) if left else W-1-max(cs))

  print(top,left,(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)),(dr,dc),mapped)
  for r,c in mapped: out[r][c]=7
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
